author: Noema II
title: HDP + RegCal + learned scalar gate (main↔motif), k=5 — seed=42
abstract: Hybrid Dual-Path with main mean+max and motif max (k=5), augmented with per-sample learned scalar gating between paths and regression calibration (L2 pre-norm + head dropout=0.05). Tests if adaptive fusion improves stability and average score over RegCal-only.

original_submission.content:
import sys, optax
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from hybrid_dual_path import build_network  # existing HDP backbone with main+motif
# Assumes hybrid_dual_path supports hparams: fusion ('avg'|'scalar_gate'), motif_kernel, regcal_l2, head_dropout

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        # backbone/experts
        'hidden_dim': 256,
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.10,
        'motif_kernel': 5,
        'main_aggregator': 'mean_max',
        # fusion + calibration
        'fusion': 'scalar_gate',          # learned 2-way softmax gate (main vs motif)
        'post_norm': True,
        'regcal_l2': True,                # L2 normalization before regression head
        'head_dropout': 0.05,             # regression head dropout
        # optimization
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'grad_clip': 1.0
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return build_network(hparams.get('d_output', 1), hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'), hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

def complete(params, opt_state, trial_data):
    ds, vm = trial_data.get('dataset'), trial_data.get('val_metric')
    print(f"[Complete] {ds} val_metric={vm}")
